current_evidence: The council's 'National and local planning validation requirements' page links 'local planning validation requirements - January 2026 (PDF, 673KB)' as the local list, alongside a separate Minerals & Waste list ('accessible August 2025'). The page mentions no newer version or consultation.

issues.detail: List date 2025-12-01 comes from the upload folder in the URL. The document and the council's link text both say 'Updated January 2026'.
issues.evidence: Link text: 'local planning validation requirements - January 2026'; title 'Local Planning Validation Requirements - Updated January 2026'

issues.detail: Grokbot mixed in the superseded July 2023 checklist ('Local Validation Checklist final July2023 Table 2'), which the council's validation page no longer links. Several rows and many tab_items come from it: Householder Tree Survey, Design and Access Statement, levels/sections, Lighting, Telecommunications, LBC Heritage Statement, Minerals ground investigation, and the Barrow/Eden legacy 'n/a' text.
issues.evidence: Validation page links only the January 2026 list and the Minerals & Waste list (Aug 2025); source field on rows = '.../2023-09/Local%20Validation%20Checklist%20final%20July2023%20Table%202.pdf'

issues.detail: The January 2026 list has 61 named requirements, and these have no app_type row. Aerodrome Safeguarding Statement (Walney Airport / Glassonby airfield). Agricultural Buildings Appraisal (new agricultural buildings). Amendment Statement (amended plans during the application). Annexe Accommodation Justification Statement (separate annexes). Biomass Boiler Statement (any biomass boiler; appears only as a 'Submission rules' tab_item). Climate Change Statement (new homes, commercial and infrastructure; BREEAM 'very good' over 1,000 sqm). Construction Management Plan (construction or demolition; only the CEMP is captured). Delivery and Servicing Plan (commercial/residential servicing, outline or hybrid). Hedgerow Assessments (Hedgerow Regulations hedges; full, outline, reserved matters, s73). Materials Schedule (listed building, major, conservation areas). Master-planned caravan site improvements (Arnside & Silverdale NL, SLDC only). Private Water Supply Assessment (more demand on a private supply, including some domestic extensions). Public Art Strategy (over 20 units or over 1,000 sqm commercial, Barrow). Residential Management Plan (HMOs, student or contractor accommodation). Retention of Community Facilities (loss of a community facility, 9 months' marketing). Transport Form. Utilities Survey.

Outline, Reserved matters and s73 are recorded as '(none)', but the source applies local requirements to them. Hedgerow Assessments apply to full, outline, reserved matters and variation-of-condition applications. Landscape and Planting Schemes need indicative detail for outline and full detail for reserved matters. A Delivery and Servicing Plan is needed for outline/hybrid applications with servicing. Removing an agricultural or countryside occupancy condition needs the agricultural appraisal or 9 months' marketing.
issues.evidence: Hedgerow Assessments: 'Applies to full, outline, reserved matters, and condition-variation applications'; Landscape and Planting Schemes: 'Outline applications need indicative information...'

issues.detail: Householder has only one row (Tree Survey, from the superseded 2023 doc), although the 2026 list applies items to householder proposals. These are the Biodiversity Assessment for some small householder proposals in designated sites, the Foul Drainage Assessment form for non-mains systems (including domestic extensions), the Private Water Supply Assessment for some domestic extensions, the CIL form for extensions near or over 100 sqm (SLDC legacy area), and the Heritage Statement where heritage assets are affected. Listed building consent lacks the Materials Schedule and 1:1 to 1:20 window plans.
issues.evidence: Foul drainage form: 'any new or existing non-mains system, including domestic extensions'; Materials Schedule: 'Listed building applications...'

issues.detail: Items from the separate Minerals & Waste (county matter) list are placed under general application types. Agricultural Land Classification/Soils (Policy DC21), BNG (trigger text from DC13 energy minerals), Employment/Economic Statement, Landscaping scheme, 'Minerals / Waste specific statements', Pre-application and 'Sunlight to gardens' all come from the M&W PDF but sit under Full planning. 'Lighting Assessment' is placed under Discharge of conditions, also from M&W text. 'External Lighting Assessment' sits under Listed building consent only because its trigger mentions floodlighting near a listed building.
issues.evidence: source field = '.../2025-08/Local%20Validation%20Requirements%20for%20Minerals%20%26%20Waste%20Developments...'; Lighting trigger: 'floodlighting in the vicinity of residential property, a listed building or a conservation area'

issues.detail: About 45 rows are put under Full planning with an 'INFERRED' note, although the source often states thresholds or types. For example, CEMP is for major development (10+ units, 1,000 sqm+), the Energy Statement and Planning Statement are for major applications, and the Health Impact Assessment is for over 100 dwellings.
issues.evidence: Notes: 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text of a general local list; placed under Full planning'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts come from neighbouring rows of the PDF table. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is 'an arboricultural method statement will be required.' (no such item in the list). 'Waste / Refuse' uses Affordable Housing text. 'Floor plans / Elevations' uses Aerodrome/Accessible Homes text. 'Block plan' uses Street Scene text. 'Existing and proposed site levels' uses tree survey schedule text. 'EIA' uses paper copies/Planning Statement text. 'BNG' uses climate change/energy minerals text. 'CIL' runs into CMP/pollution text. The Householder Tree Survey row runs into Barrow transport-form text.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows trigger_excerpt fields, e.g. Waste: 'Waste Management Statement 3 ... Affordable Housing Statement A financial viability report / appraisal will be required...'

issues.detail: Some triggers are empty or cut off before the threshold, so the source thresholds are lost. Examples: Tall buildings ('Tall Building Assessment When required / what is required'), Noise ('should accompany applications for: whether the'), Highways ('Submission is required before validation where a development: Highway details and a'), Open space (no trigger), Coal Mining (only 'Eden Local Plan DEV1'), Agricultural Land Classification ('regarding the site.'). The source gives thresholds, for example Air Quality at 50+ parking spaces (25+ in an AQMA), residential over 80 units or 1.0ha, and the Open Space Assessment for major applications or loss of open space.

Most of the 49 tab_items are drawing conventions, file rules, guidance links, fees or sentence fragments. Examples: 'All plans must be submitted in PDF format', 'Use clear, descriptive file names', 'Please do not provide a file name as a drawing number', 'Fit A4 or A3 paper, show North direction', 'New homes will be subject to inspection by Building Control', a fee note ('separate fee payable ... for applications requiring a viability assessment'), 'This is called nutrient neutrality.', 'A summary guide and frequently asked questions - NE776', 'Nutrient Neutrality When required:', 'nutrient neutrality mitigation strategy; and', and 'For more information please see Contaminated Land Strategy'. The 'Pre-application advice' row ('expectations on pre-application discussions.') is not a validation requirement.
issues.evidence: tab_items sections 'Drawing / document standards', 'Submission rules', 'Policy-driven requirements'

issues.detail: Several items are duplicated. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' and 'Foul Sewage / Utilities Statement' share the same foul-drainage form text, even though the source has separate items (Foul and Surface Water Drainage, Surface Water/SuDS, Utilities Survey). 'Habitats Regulations Assessment' and 'Nutrient Neutrality' rows use the same NNAMS text. The NNAMS heading is repeated in about 8 tab_items, and the Accessible and Adaptable Homes Statement Form text appears 3 times. 'Transport Assessment' and 'Travel Plan' come from the combined source item.

Grokbot dropped the legacy-area limits that the source attaches to items. CIL applies to the SLDC legacy area only, as do the Appendix 1 climate measures and the caravan-site master plan. The Aerodrome statement applies only to the Walney and Glassonby areas. Rows read as council-wide requirements.
issues.evidence: CIL: 'SLDC legacy area only'; Climate Change Statement: 'Appendix 1 measures apply to the SLDC legacy area only'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current January 2026 list (dated by URL as Dec 2025). The extraction mixes in the superseded July 2023 checklist and the separate Minerals & Waste list. About 17 of the 61 named requirements are missing, many triggers come from adjacent table rows, and outline, reserved matters and householder requirements are wrongly marked as none.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
